meta.scope: Only /, /creare-magazin-online/, /creare-site-web/, /agentie-google-ads/, the shared header and footer (with the contact section and cookie banner on every page), as built in dist/ on 2026-10-23; the header menu (desktop, tablet, mobile) re-checked against main@9fc0ca6 on 2026-10-30.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: The brand orange (Elementor global Primary; `--orange` in the store page CSS, `--gads-orange` on Google Ads). Fills: filled buttons, the highlight chip behind heading words, the checklist panel, process-step cards, FAQ answer bubbles, the 'Pentru cine e' panel and the ticket check discs, the 'În preț' panel, recommended badges, the active language, back-to-top, the desktop header highlight and filled submenu icon discs. Lines: 3px price-card borders, dashed process and scope borders, the open FAQ outline, the tablet header link underline. Text and icons: the current page in the desktop header, hovered submenu titles, display H1s, eyebrows, card and package names, FAQ numbers, service icons. 2.42:1 against `white` in both directions, under WCAG AA even for large text; `ink` on `orange` reads 6.14:1.

tokens.name: orange-logo
tokens.usage: The logo blob's orange. First stop of the 270deg button and card gradients (to `orange`) on Google Ads and the homepage CTA band, and of the 135deg 'Hai să ne cunoaștem' tile (to `orange-hot`) on the store page; the header button fill at 89% (#ff6c2ae3); header links on hover and the current page from 768 to 1024px; the burger lines and the open burger in the mobile menu. `white` on it reads 2.83:1.

tokens.name: orange-light
tokens.usage: Light end of the contact-section gradient (135deg, `orange-light` to `orange-hot`). `white` text on it reads 2.13:1.

tokens.name: orange-hot
tokens.usage: Dark end of the contact gradient and of the store page's CTA tile; the current page in the mobile menu (20px/600, underlined). 3.19:1 on `white`: enough only for text 24px+ or bold 19px+.

tokens.name: orange-border
tokens.usage: The 2px border of the header button 'Ai o idee?'. Used nowhere else.

tokens.name: orange-deep
tokens.usage: The orange for small text and focus: the 2px focus outline in the header, submenu and language switch, the hovered inactive language, the mobile-menu focus outline and hovered links, stop labels ('Oprirea 1') and receipt values ('GRATUIT') on the store page, the metro-section eyebrow, the ticket icons and the store's 'După lansare' card icons. 5.89:1 on `white`, 5.38:1 on `peach-menu`, 5.30:1 on `peach`.

tokens.name: orange-check
tokens.usage: Receipt line numbers 01 and 02 on the store page ('Bon de proiect'); 03 and 04 use `orange-deep`. 5.95:1 on `white`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text everywhere (Elementor global Text; `--ink`): headings, body copy, inputs, footer. 14.85:1 on `white`, 13.81:1 on `cream`, 13.34:1 on `peach`, 6.14:1 on `orange`. Also the dark bento tile, the barcode, the 3px focus outline on the store, Google Ads and FAQ controls, and the FAQ +/- indicator.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: the contact privacy note, the CTA note under the store hero, package subtitles, ticket worries, submenu descriptions, '/ lună' and plan limits on Google Ads, the mobile-menu language links. 7.38:1 on `white`, 6.63:1 on `peach`.
